metadata.question: Did the land area of Smith Island decrease between 1999 and 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to detect land vs water for Smith Island (Chesapeake Bay, Maryland) at two time points: 1999 and 2019 - Landsat 5 for 1999 (available until 2011), Landsat 8/9 for 2019 - Smith Island location: approximately (-76.03, 37.97) - Use summer months for best water detection (less cloud cover) 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds to get accurate land/water classification - Use water indices (NDWI or MNDWI) to distinguish land from water - Water typically has NDWI > 0, land has NDWI < 0 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If land area calculation succeeds and shows actual decrease/increase/same - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If all pixels masked out after cloud removal - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or unrealistic values - A: If land area decreased (2019 < 1999) - B: If land area same or increased (2019 >= 1999) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Smith Island location (Chesapeake Bay, Maryland) const smithIsland = ee.Geometry.Point([-76.03, 37.97]).buffer(3000); // 2. Data acquisition for 1999 (Landsat 5) const col1999 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(smithIsland) .filterDate('1999-05-01', '1999-10-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); const size1999 = col1999.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1999 Images found: ${size1999}`); if (size1999 === 0) { console.log('No images for 1999'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Data acquisition for 2019 (Landsat 8) const col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(smithIsland) .filterDate('2019-05-01', '2019-10-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images found: ${size2019}`); if (size2019 === 0) { console.log('No images for 2019'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Cloud masking function for Landsat function maskL8sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask); } function maskL5sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask); } // 5. Calculate MNDWI and get land pixels function addMNDWI_L5(image) { const green = image.select('SR_B2').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const swir = image.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const mndwi = green.subtract(swir).divide(green.add(swir)).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } function addMNDWI_L8(image) { const green = image.select('SR_B3').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const swir = image.select('SR_B6').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const mndwi = green.subtract(swir).divide(green.add(swir)).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } // 6. Process 1999 data const img1999 = col1999.map(maskL5sr).map(addMNDWI_L5).median(); const land1999 = img1999.select('MNDWI').lt(0); const count1999 = land1999.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: smithIsland, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`1999 valid pixels: ${count1999}`); if (count1999 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 1999'); console.log('C2'); return; } const landArea1999 = land1999.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: smithIsland, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); // 7. Process 2019 data const img2019 = col2019.map(maskL8sr).map(addMNDWI_L8).median(); const land2019 = img2019.select('MNDWI').lt(0); const count2019 = land2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: smithIsland, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 valid pixels: ${count2019}`); if (count2019 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2019'); console.log('C2'); return; } const landArea2019 = land2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: smithIsland, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); // 8. Validation and final answer if (landArea1999 === null || landArea2019 === null || isNaN(landArea1999) || isNaN(landArea2019)) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Land pixels 1999: ${landArea1999.toFixed(0)}`); console.log(`Land pixels 2019: ${landArea2019.toFixed(0)}`); const change = ((landArea2019 - landArea1999) / landArea1999 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${change}%`); if (landArea2019 < landArea1999) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
